// Stands in for "dart_mutant" in the tests of `test_gates mutation`. Kept as
// .txt so that it is not analyzed or formatted with the package; the tests
// copy it into a temporary directory and run it there, in the package.
//
// Usage: dart fake_dart_mutant.dart --version
//        dart fake_dart_mutant.dart run <options>
//
// What it does is read from "fake.json" in the current directory (every key
// is optional):
//
//   "version": "0.2.0"     what --version prints
//   "versionExit": 0       the exit code of --version
//   "report": { ... }      written to the path of --report; without it no
//                          report is written
//   "exit": 0              the exit code of the run
//   "killed": true         the run ends itself with SIGKILL
//   "hang": true           the run writes its pid to "started" and waits
//                          for SIGINT / SIGTERM / SIGHUP. It then appends
//                          the signal to "signals.log", takes a second to
//                          "put files back", writes "put-back" and exits
//                          with 130 / 143 / 129
//   "deaf": true           with "hang": the run notes the signal and does
//                          not end
//   "launcher": true       the run is a launcher that ends before the tool
//                          behind it: it starts this script once more as
//                          that tool, lets it get to work, and ends with
//                          143. The tool waits until the launcher is gone,
//                          then sends SIGTERM to the process that started
//                          the launcher (as a terminal sends a signal to
//                          all of them, and the launcher happens to end
//                          first), takes a second to "put files back",
//                          writes "put-back" and ends
//
// A run appends its arguments to "runs.log", copies the plan it was given
// to "plan.seen.json", and the report that was at --report before it wrote
// its own to "report.before.json".
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

String? valueOf(List<String> arguments, String name) {
  final index = arguments.indexOf(name);
  return index == -1 ? null : arguments[index + 1];
}

Future<void> main(List<String> arguments) async {
  final file = File('fake.json');
  final fake = file.existsSync()
      ? jsonDecode(file.readAsStringSync()) as Map<String, Object?>
      : const <String, Object?>{};
  if (arguments.contains('--version')) {
    stdout.writeln(fake['version'] ?? '0.2.0');
    exitCode = fake['versionExit'] as int? ?? 0;
    return;
  }
  File('runs.log').writeAsStringSync(
    '${arguments.join(' ')}\n',
    mode: FileMode.append,
  );
  if (arguments.first == '--tool-behind-launcher') {
    // <pid of the launcher> <pid of what started the launcher>
    final launcher = arguments[1];
    final starter = int.parse(arguments[2]);
    File('started').writeAsStringSync('$pid');
    while (Process.runSync('kill', ['-0', launcher]).exitCode == 0) {
      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 5));
    }
    Process.killPid(starter, ProcessSignal.sigterm);
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1));
    File('put-back').writeAsStringSync('yes');
    return;
  }
  if (fake['launcher'] == true) {
    final parent = (Process.runSync('ps', ['-o', 'ppid=', '-p', '$pid']).stdout
            as String)
        .trim();
    await Process.start(Platform.resolvedExecutable, [
      Platform.script.toFilePath(),
      '--tool-behind-launcher',
      '$pid',
      parent,
    ], mode: ProcessStartMode.inheritStdio);
    while (!File('started').existsSync()) {
      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 25));
    }
    // Long enough for the one who started this to have seen the tool.
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 1500));
    exit(143);
  }
  final plan = valueOf(arguments, '--plan');
  if (plan != null) {
    File(plan).copySync('plan.seen.json');
  }
  final report = File(valueOf(arguments, '--report')!);
  if (report.existsSync()) {
    report.copySync('report.before.json');
  }
  if (fake['hang'] == true) {
    final signals = [
      (ProcessSignal.sigint, 130),
      (ProcessSignal.sigterm, 143),
      (ProcessSignal.sighup, 129),
    ];
    var got = false;
    for (final (signal, code) in signals) {
      signal.watch().listen((_) async {
        File('signals.log').writeAsStringSync(
          '$signal\n',
          mode: FileMode.append,
        );
        if (got) {
          return;
        }
        got = true;
        if (fake['deaf'] == true) {
          return;
        }
        await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1));
        File('put-back').writeAsStringSync('yes');
        exit(code);
      });
    }
    File('started').writeAsStringSync('$pid');
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(minutes: 5));
    exit(99);
  }
  if (fake.containsKey('report')) {
    report.parent.createSync(recursive: true);
    report.writeAsStringSync(jsonEncode(fake['report']));
  }
  if (fake['killed'] == true) {
    Process.killPid(pid, ProcessSignal.sigkill);
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(minutes: 5));
  }
  exitCode = fake['exit'] as int? ?? 0;
}
